name: raw_action_topic
meaning: first topic, equal to keccak256 of the text below (computed in this tool)

name: raw_action_text
meaning: event signature text

name: events_label
meaning: label in the decode error, length 0x10

name: core_address_low
meaning: first 16 bytes of the log address compare

name: core_address_high
meaning: last 4 bytes of the log address compare

name: raw_length_cap
meaning: cmp $0x3e8,%rdx at the host: raw action above 1000 bytes is dropped

name: short_raw_gate
meaning: len - 4, then jae on -3: lengths 1, 2, 3 are dropped, length 0 is tested before

name: version_gate
meaning: cmp $0x1,%r10b: version 1 only, after the disabled set

name: action_bound
meaning: dec, cmp $0xf: actions 1 to 16

name: disabled_key_stride
meaning: disabled set keys are 0x10 wide: u8 at +0, u64 at +8

name: limit_word
meaning: 0x0ccccccccccccccc bound on price, size and oid

name: row_stride
meaning: imul $0x128: a pushed row is 0x128 bytes

name: topic_count_gate
meaning: cmp $0x1,%r12: exactly one topic gives the length mismatch error, two or more pass

name: host_call
meaning: call through slot 0x5774048 inside the log loop of 0x2448500

name: first_decoder_call
meaning: call through slot 0x5774038 (0x34273d0) before the raw action host, tag 1 takes the log

name: loop_call
meaning: 0x2760a70 calls the block function 0x2448500

name: row_sentinel
meaning: tag 0xcc ends the row loop in 0x2760a70

name: loop_stride
meaning: imul $0x128 in 0x2760a70

name: enqueue_call
meaning: each row goes to the delay wrapper 0x27584a0

name: system_send_tag
meaning: first list rows become tag 0xad and run at once through 0x2759240

name: native_system_user
meaning: native token rows use sender bytes 0x22
